text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I've reached it... a new 'phase.'
I've attained...'luminescence.'

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I felt everyone's "signal"...
A strong waveform... A higher-dimensional "connect".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Did Neo Universe's share reach there too...?
At the end of the voyage... if we could become a 'binary star.'"
choice_data_list: It came through loud and clear! That was a great run!
It's getting through! That was a great run!
Let's get stronger so we can understand each other even better.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Gathering "luminescence,"
to one day become someone who brings the "tide" to others...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The singularity... I can see it.
I'm going to welcome it... How "exciting."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Looking ahead... the forecast is "turbulence." We'll need the strength to keep from being swallowed up, won't we?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Load, friction, and repulsion are... "neutrinos."
Neo Universe takes flight.
